name: What are the signs that my roof is beyond repair and needs a full replacement?

mainEntity.name: What are the signs that my roof is beyond repair and needs a full replacement?

acceptedAnswer.text: Signs that your roof is beyond repair and requires a full replacement include widespread missing or cracked shingles, significant granule loss (often visible in gutters), a sagging roof deck, visible water damage or mold in your attic, or if your roof is nearing the end of its expected lifespan (typically 20-25 years for asphalt shingles). Consistent leaks in multiple areas are also a strong indicator. These issues suggest the roof's integrity is compromised, making replacement the more practical long-term solution.
acceptedAnswer.description: Widespread missing shingles, granule loss, a sagging deck, attic water damage, or an old roof are signs a full replacement is needed.
